cli_group_help: STL model analysis and slicer setting recommendations.
cmd_analyze_help: Analyze a model and report geometry, problems and overhangs.
cmd_fix_help: Repair common mesh problems and write a fixed STL.
cmd_suggest_help: Suggest slicer settings as a JSON profile.
cmd_orient_help: Suggest the best print orientation and write a rotated STL.
cmd_merge_help: Merge separate bodies into a single piece and write an STL.
cmd_discover_help: List filament/process profiles found in locally installed slicers.
cmd_batch_help: Analyze every STL in a folder and print a summary.
cmd_pack_help: Pack many STLs onto the printer bed and emit one combined STL per bed.
cmd_serve_help: Launch the local web interface (browser UI).
cmd_app_help: Open as a native desktop window (needs the [desktop] extra).
opt_fix_output: Where to write the repaired STL.
opt_suggest_import: Use a material profile exported from your slicer (.json/.ini/.fdm_material).
opt_suggest_export: Write slicer-importable profile files instead of printing JSON.
opt_suggest_printer: Target printer name for --export orca (e.g. "Creality K1 Max 0.4 nozzle").
opt_suggest_price: Filament price per kg (e.g. 25). Adds a cost estimate to the output.
opt_suggest_currency: Currency label shown next to cost (e.g. TL, USD, EUR).
opt_orient_output: Where to write the re-oriented STL.
opt_merge_output: Where to write the merged STL.
opt_pack_bed: Bed size as WxD in mm (default 420x420 — fits Anycubic Kobra Max / Creality CR-10 Max).
opt_pack_rotate: Allow 90° rotation about Z to improve fit.
opt_pack_outdir: Directory for packed STLs and layout.json.
msg_no_issues: No issues found — ready for slicing.
msg_orient_optimal: Current orientation is already optimal — no rotation applied.
msg_no_profiles: No slicer profiles found in standard install locations.
msg_no_profiles_hint: Slicer not installed or profiles are in a custom path.
